title: UPDATE: Ideogram 4.5 Ranks No. 18 in Image Edit Arena Top 20
summary:
The Artificial Analysis Image-Editing v2.0 board ranked the latest image model from Ideogram at No. 23, marking the AI startup's first appearance on that leaderboard. The tool also placed No. 34 on the AA-Image-T2I board, climbing from No. 40 for version 4.0, and scored 1351 points to rank No. 18 overall in the Image Edit Arena. According to a review by Artificial Analysis, the model currently trails HiDream-O1-Edit-1.5 and HunyuanImage 3.0 Instruct but sits ahead of ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Lite.

Launched on September 30, Ideogram 4.5 is now live on fal, Krea, Glif, and Venice, alongside the company's own API. The model's architecture preserves 94-99% of unedited pixels across ten sequential modifications to prevent color drift and artifacting. High-quality edits are priced at $0.22 per image, while lower quality tiers start at $0.008 per image. Ideogram plans to publish the model's open weights in the near future.

Exciting news: Ideogram 4.5 by @ideogram_ai has entered the Image Edit Arena’s top 20!

This release scored 1351 pts, and ranking #18 overall. Ideogram 4.5 landed within the top 20 for the following Image Edit categories:
- #14 in 3D Imaging & Modeling 
- #15 in Product & Commercial Design
- #17 across Cartoon, Anime & Fantasy; Photorealistic & Cinematic; and Text Rendering
- #18 in Portraits
Ranking for Art coming soon.

Ideogram's release notes highlight that this launch focuses on a unique capability for multi-turn edits existing pixels are persevered. Check out more details in their post.

Congrats to the @ideogram_ai team on this release!

selectedTweets.text:
Ideogram 4.5 debuts at #23 on the AA-Image-Editing v2.0 leaderboard, Ideogram's first model on the board, and lands at #34 on AA-Image-T2I v2.0

Ideogram 4.5 is Ideogram's new image editing model, released on September 30. Ideogram positions it as a high precision edit model, built to reduce pixel shifts, color changes and texture artifacts across multi-turn edits. It also supports Text to Image. We evaluated Ideogram 4.5 at “high” quality level.

In Image Editing, Ideogram 4.5 takes #23, just behind HiDream-O1-Edit-1.5 and HunyuanImage 3.0 Instruct and ahead of ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Lite. In Text to Image it ranks #34, climbing from #40 for Ideogram 4.0.

At the High quality setting we evaluated, Ideogram 4.5 is priced at $0.22 per image ($220 per 1k images) for edits and $0.10 per image ($100 per 1k) for Text to Image. Lower quality tiers start at $0.008 per image for edits and $0.03 per image for Text to Image.

Ideogram 4.5 is live in Ideogram, the Ideogram API and Ideogram's launch partners, with open weights coming soon.

Congratulations to @ideogram_ai on the release!

See below for our analysis and example outputs of Ideogram 4.5 in the Artificial Analysis Image Arena 🧵
